## Kerr County Gets Flood Warning Sirens
Kerr County has received eight [flood warning sirens](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu2yAUxvGnsTciINjEA0MXb7drR-tcc7CPgiGCkxC_fZW2b9D5k_769Pv1tXwBRUrbTzjQ8TvkJWGrEZmxLA1KorRVKphqyflOmAPveC5a6lFII_S0eKB4Lqb37lv6SfXolLXWjHKYVL87QAhXwPEbBr1KO63rTY2DsTB4qay59eQ-MWn0pJS8yuly1SHgTSsYtNVKms5I9MS5XHhHxjfUEM_8wnJZ89FHtzM_anf90em503Nr7XJ_Q_qMnZ4pvbAybcCUU-30_Ewei0jYRIQm7liKWPMz8Sk25CoClcoiP9nnXMQ_APFXQFASTAeKkItY4Xh8en1x_tEoRqqj7YzcDqD45xn_n-fL6d8BAAD__-gCjhA) mandated by lawmakers in the aftermath of last summer's deadly flash floods. Local officials expect to receive more sirens in the near future. The sirens will be installed within the next month along the Guadalupe River near 10 summer camps, including both Camp Mystic locations. The "most critical" areas with dense summer populations have been prioritized for the first sirens [purchased](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGOqyAYhZ8GdxhAKnXBoht37fYmd2NQfpQUwcDfWt9-4sy8wWy_k5yc8_27D3fjg4_zw6yg8ePSEGEvARAhD7vJ0ce5-Ayx5JSeHpLDBY5BMNFSJqnoBmt8OAZZWT0y2_EKNFdKyZZdOl4t2qmLtKrtYGrHqxkbJVjbwGSbhpur5aby-ixjUnScs4Z1dSOcg6vg5iKU4EwSycB6TLnGBRA-prhwpDfkekprFfSCuBXS3Ijoiej3fa_XEs-MiB4ifZWTgsEFMhE9pq1gyh5O_ISc6ZReEQ-Kic6A1PlckLqQkqW__-mPADqCSxloea0rZDqZdSs0bRCJ6E2mtxv_j49jqbK22-5D8KVVRLJ5NT58T8W_CX5r8RUAAP__zSmTPA) by the Upper Guadalupe River Authority. During a public hearing at the Texas Capitol on Monday, an attorney hired to investigate the disaster [testified](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAMQL8mdBklmQzZFBTX0O21VyIPOGBtiEeJd1j-_sT9wlV2YfnpvT-f0ydQprL-hh0H-Uk8FTxaRhGs0wG1UFkbVSytMn8RcpINz8kZ12vjtYvTApTPyXfL8DRLtB0ONoTge_OIttuGcJ8fIaa7jQu4-Ox7m2J8BABA82H8s6Phema8i9aau4m3u0sJP5yFhwvOGq-8wYWE6002FPyBlvLJb6y3mfcuD5vIq6n7L-VG5cbjOG5zpvnLbfzdhMt1pdx4aV0DhLhAVm68sMqNxl97UG6cYX_p_WxCs66YCRfNRQti0TN_l4aZa9MHyaYLa9yxrljmU0sFujrpJyauqFNmXjSVNzahFYSrbnBe9K4Oy-ugnKn1QXmz7kD5n4b8X_z34P4GAAD__7Wpm8o) that Camp Mystic lacked an evacuation plan, did not provide emergency training for counselors, and was understaffed. "_There was never any real training, no drills of any kind_ ," said Casey Garrett. Garrett also shared that camp operator Dick Eastland, who died trying to rescue campers in his truck, [checked his phone](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOrSAUhp9GOwwg3gqK09jt005pUBa6MggG1uj27SfuV5j6v-X_vl7Ty6DHsP43O2h6uzgFuLIHIkjTZVLAsGZMEHKK8RshOtrgniSXLeOKyWGyBv09qdLqmdtBlKBF13Wq5c0gyk23TdMr6Wq5mFnUtl2EekQ1i77pBYgS9VPGlRyE4DUfqlo6B70UppGdFFwVioNFiqmiDQjeJjt_xxNStcS99HojOnJR_yvkWMjxuq7KxXdnfjJheCyFHJ9PhRw_YbaY_WD7nQkX5nyMlmE4IROuhjAGdiQ4IZCZPTALhrZcJm2PC73H3HaF4utu0H_W6W_MTi1_AwAA___cVIMl) repeatedly for weather updates after the National Weather Service issued a flash flood warning at 1:14 a.m. on Friday, July 4. "_We do know that Dick Eastland loved every little girl that came to Camp Mystic. He was a loving man_ ," said Garrett.
## Cooper Flagg Wins Rookie of the Year
Dallas Mavericks forward Cooper Flagg was named [NBA Rookie of the Year](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdBPZEydAQZGG7r1imy3RYAawYmxkT8Lj71fZ_YTtrnSlq3vO76_hi3zwcfmmjTv5mdMQ-SiBRTgPB-Xo41J85lhySk_PaZaVzwE13kFbwHaYyIdzsNXUjXpqTcWdqeva3vWtNdXa2QkZm_vEqB035Nzt2oyuttwaV09NW_nuM6Yttsboq24vV5xnbtDQDWs02iqrefKS8kVWFv6hMoczvTlfXNqq0K0ie1HXh8JeYX8cx2Ur8dMp7DnCqyjsy56yfEIcSWG_0Zuzd88CLqWdM8yBlgUOHwvEkeAfK6QZZGU4mTKMTOLjAukl4FbKIYlwgWeK8Iwv3ncOCnvK8Hig-ZXO7yp30374EHy518rqZSMf_l6W_xP97vBPAAAA__9WR5W2) on Monday, joining Jason Kidd and Luka Doncic as the third player in franchise history to win the award. At just 19 years old, he's the second-youngest player to receive the honor, trailing only LeBron James. Flagg averaged 21 points, 6.7 rebounds, 4.5 assists, and 1.2 steals per game this season, leading the Mavs in all four categories. The last rookie to achieve that feat was [Michael Jordan](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO8yAUBODT4A7r8YxNKCj-xl3-dksLzHOMQiDCKMS3X2X3CFuPNKNvvq7L1YYY0u2_fZCp7y0vidoRqVYqS7MlhXQ7QqF0lJzvgfJWdzoXBJw4SI568TbEc5GdNw68Fh0ZoZSSE4xadLtxF_LjoJ1cUXmFQioS47peBkCYnNNdMJ8ykKiFgAF0P-C20QWFHVGhAMkkkA81l77uVOltjy2e-UWlX_Oji2av9Xmw4R_DmeHcWuuTs5-M4fzBMJzvwfLkLP818LzxuhM_yRaOgCPHqSvGP1uIMRyTYhJuDxviz0D92y0vg98BAAD__9yadeE). Flagg edged out former Duke teammate Kon Knueppel of the Charlotte Hornets by just [26 total points](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOrCAUQL9GOwxcGZGC4jV289otzVUuShbBABnHv9_M_sL2J-ck5-s5P9EHH7f_eJCpb5fmSFcJVCvl-cIcfdyKzxRLTunbU3J1p3sGDgPjkoGeLfpwz7K1ZuFWi5aMUErJgT-0aHdjx2V1PQnrlnHVVo9CDT0ODiU6KwdsvfnIuAQtBO-57npwjkYQ-AAFgstGcrK-ptzVnSq9sbhwpxflbk1HG8xe61ma_l8DUwNTOVOupbtxT-kDNDBhrn4NVBqYLIaAha0pnZSZC7ht7PKxsLggg14qEFKqbq9HaLOx5-VD8GVQjeTbgT78JuvfRr0M_AQAAP__E6F-Pg) for the award, the second-tightest vote margin in over two decades. It's the first time college teammates finished first and second for the award. "_I came here to compete and help this team win_ ," [Flagg said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAYhJ8GOwz8sroUFNfY7bVXml_5UbIoGyC6vv3FvUe4diYzmW9-HsMDffDb_I0rmfJ2cdjoyIFKoTQcmDa_zdkn2nKK8ekpurLQOYCAlgvFQQ8WfTgHVVkzCqtlRUZ2XadacdOyWgxKbKAjK-9C67HVAkaF6t5o5Wyj5a3y5ioTCrSUohG6bsA5uoPEG3QghWJKkPUlprosVOiN2YUz7pTqKa5VMEspr8yaLwY9g_44jnoa80Vx-Qz6T4RBf0kMeoshYOYr7pT89Mx8ivFFibuA88y3EfkfKY-Ol4X4SZgY9FUy9nX4EHxuO6bEvKIPnwXlf7_tBn4DAAD__3K_gy8) of the accomplishment. "_This is just one step forward in what we're building_."
## Filming Begins for Season 7 of _The Chosen_
Filming [has begun](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO6yAUheHVmA4LLtiYguI17vLaKS0cru2rwRABipPdjzJbmPpIn3T-r9ty8xQp7f_9ia69trwkvGrE1rAsly-J0l6pYKol52_CvLUD3wsIGLnQHOwSPMX3ollwqwhWMnTSGKNHMVjJDocKhJVmCGaaAlqjRiUnZaX1yq96HRi5DyY0WCmFErZXsG04gfQDGJBCd1pgoJZL3w5s-PJ1i-_8xNLf88miO1p71E7962DuYL6uq_c5frYO5s-ZDub7kSsmvuJOqfKKvubEDd8onpR2DkIZsIOF_mhnZMWFx0UxUh1Np8V-evr1WPtboaeDnwAAAP__nxR5hA) for the seventh and final season of _The Chosen_ , the historical drama based on the life of Jesus. name: Kimberly Bretches
subject: We have very little time to act before Chance's trial begins
body:
My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you.

| | | | Dear Friend,This is me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlslanjupkjrcp1r71f0g2h6dshhrbgl1rpf65sg_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5jm6or6cth2bs)
---
This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because NEXT MONTH, a police-hating, Soros-funded prosecutor will try to rip my husband away from our family and lock him up for life for doing his job.I should explain.For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off.And my husband made it home safe and sound.But what Chance didn’t know is that one of the beanbags he fired wound up hurting a rioter’s hand.And nearly TWO YEARS after my husband helped save our city from being burned to the ground, the county prosecutor decided to charge my husband with “aggravated assault by a public servant”—a charge punishable by life in prison.This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters.What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-police crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make police officers pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared, there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group that has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policeman's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? **[Would you help by sending a one-time gift to LELDF so this amazing group can defend my husband and the other good police officers who have been wrongly accused?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl5ohve06og8b2b7vaio0612nhm8d1a87hot7n9g_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5jm6or6cth2bs)** You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. _[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9b372ds8ct3cc59mure634s4qsoq58ag90tp670_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5jm6or6cth2bs)_[__](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zotn6cng81fm9k36ft8kg4as4idhletq65qqn3sg_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5jm6or6cth2bs)__[_**So with that in mind, please know that any contribution -- be it $35, $100, $500 or even $1,000 -- is tax-deductible.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6pb82oeld72uf635neh8p5h48hcum1l5i29nt90_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5jm6or6cth2bs) But whatever you feel led to give, please send it back quickly.Chance’s trial starts next month.Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense.Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he’ll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison.He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle someday... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. _[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpdm87v1i9497euk7jvd5j7f2blcpke2c3tjfqno_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5jm6or6cth2bs)_[__](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z00co8l6p2582edjsqmgtiuj1ootg058d4vk5g30_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5jm6or6cth2bs)__[_**So please, my friend, make your gift right away if possible.**_ ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9ghjshl68psklgc74plurd27giih5s5d8bussv8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5jm6or6cth2bs) With this radical Soros-funded prosecutor on the warpath, _**[your gift of $35](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0hrnan687rf8p3g3hu5qnmk0eop2saq6t2c9028_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5jm6or6cth2bs)**_ \-- or any amount -- could be the difference between Chance clearing his good name... ...and spending the rest of his life behind bars. Thank you for reading my email today with such a generous spirit. I can never express how grateful I am to you -- in advance -- for helping my husband fight back.
---
With hope and thanks,
---
Kimberly Bretches
---
P.S. My husband Chance put his life on the line to keep our city safe from a rabid mob of violent protesters. Now life behind bars could be his “reward.” And to make things worse, we’re up against the deep pockets of a George Soros-backed prosecutor in court. We have very little time to act before Chance’s trial begins next month. Chance and I have four children—including a brand new baby that wasn’t born when the photo I sent you was taken. Please don’t let them grow up without their father. **[Thank you for any help you can send to LELDF today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zckcl1p1ggm9e1c5igbjf1pnt5dofgttaa3up478_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5jm6or6cth2bs)**
---
|
---

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | When the SpaceX IPO hits, trillions of dollars inside the financial system will move. | | Dear Friend,
I am writing today with news that I have been looking forward to sharing for some time.
**I am officially running for Congress in Virginia's 10th District.**
Last Friday, I qualified as a candidate, dropping off my qualification paperwork in Richmond. This Friday on May 1, we will submit my declaration of candidacy and turn in our over 1500 signatures — collected by our amazing volunteers -- to qualify for the August 4th primary ballot.
---
|

---
[X](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
| | |

I did not set out to run for Congress, I set out to serve. After thirty years in the Air Force, rising to the rank of Colonel, and most recently serving as Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense overseeing a $500 billion portfolio spanning space systems, nuclear defense, and national intelligence, I came home to Loudoun County. This is the place my family and I have called home since 2009. After seventeen years as your neighbor, I realized that taking this experience to Washington was the next right thing to do.
My campaign is built on three core commitments: restoring economic vitality by keeping taxes low and cutting burdensome regulations; ensuring safety and security in our communities by supporting the law enforcement officers who serve us; and bringing real fiscal responsibility to Washington by eliminating wasteful spending and combating the fraud that costs taxpayers billions every year. These are the values that Virginia families live by, and they are the values I will bring to Congress.

| | | [Restore Economic Vitality](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)

A campaign like this is only possible with the support of people who care about our community's future, and I am asking for yours.
There are two meaningful ways you can help:
**Donate**. Your contribution, no matter the size, will help us carry this message to every corner of the district. Every dollar makes a difference.
**Volunteer**. Join us on the ground. Make calls, knock on doors, and help build something we can all be proud of. Your time and dedication mean the world.
**Vote**. Early voting for the primary election is from June 18th - August 1st, and election is August 4th. I'd be honored to earn your vote.__

**Your donation, no matter the size, is what makes this campaign possible.**

Dave

| | | | | [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LlBUv8EhczEsSTD2aGvG63eijNOLorTzPymVulfdJfc4nDM7qMWjsUuMz1o86F_6PfZ2iBPQSA2nFIIuBC7y5CoQLI-2lqhI8KmXlRQEN4UHAQTqnDzSBdJ9a_EnwwikDNGiCna-ZuLUxKMvMoqRjom7nnxJNhGLDKvI1NBRdypH7H0EBCjrjdrWrPJPzuAAZaSAJt3zq8Xp3OUgqNyh34zDDPHHW-es&c=jttVEhTR1mnpB3Jo0N14PM7BIncs3E4-iBosLH88UuwrKLEjMTktjA==&ch=9is7RcoDTOhB-bPFRGmQS9sdQsdmBEngZg9FUBxTKL7uV4IC6TfH0w==)
---
Peter, I am a third-generation row-crop farmer from Waterproof, Louisiana in Tensas Parish. (In Louisiana a parish is like a county, for those unfamiliar.) My family and I own and oversee thousands of acres of farmland.
Being a family farmer means being a small business owner, a good steward of nature, a disciplined manager of time, and a savvy investor all in one. It took me years of struggle and learning before my farm could prosper.
During all of my time running the farm, the U.S. government did not actively try to drive farmers like myself and my neighbors out of business. But all of that changed when Trump came back to power and immediately attacked farmers with his illegal tariffs, costly foreign wars, and trade wars with countries that purchase our exports.
Now MAGA Republicans in charge of Congress are messing up the critical Farm Bill, bipartisan legislation that rural America absolutely relies on.
You see, there is a whole lot we can do through Farm Bill legislation to help not only farmers in rural America but also folks everywhere who need a little help to get by.
Worthwhile programs like SNAP and WIC (for pregnant women and young children) are almost always supported in the Farm Bill. But Trump and his MAGA-controlled Congress defunded SNAP last year in their Big Ugly Bill--and now they refuse to correct that heartless policy:
---
| [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LlBUv8EhczEsSTD2aGvG63eijNOLorTzPymVulfdJfc4nDM7qMWjsUuMz1o86F_6PfZ2iBPQSA2nFIIuBC7y5CoQLI-2lqhI8KmXlRQEN4UHAQTqnDzSBdJ9a_EnwwikDNGiCna-ZuLUxKMvMoqRjom7nnxJNhGLDKvI1NBRdypH7H0EBCjrjdrWrPJPzuAAZaSAJt3zq8VRdawFuUIkpnwFSHgkY8BN&c=jttVEhTR1mnpB3Jo0N14PM7BIncs3E4-iBosLH88UuwrKLEjMTktjA==&ch=9is7RcoDTOhB-bPFRGmQS9sdQsdmBEngZg9FUBxTKL7uV4IC6TfH0w==)
---
My MAGA opponent Sen. Bill Cassidy doesn't know the first thing about what it takes to run a successful business, much less how crucial it is to support farmers.
Family farms are the heartbeat of our small towns. Our crops help keep food prices down, increase the available supply of healthy food, and reduce chronic diseases like diabetes and heart disease.
Good food is medicine. And MAGA is a poison that has infected our politics and threatens to harm us all.
[Washington needs more actual farmers who care about improving people's lives, not more Trump-first politicians. Congress is broken and it may take a farmer to show them how to fix it. Can I count on your support to help me win this race and fight for us in D.C.?](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LlBUv8EhczEsSTD2aGvG63eijNOLorTzPymVulfdJfc4nDM7qMWjsUuMz1o86F_66PUkYtXBV-RCF3vrcfWSvW9UzFkzCc2axgjJtisg8gjf1bUhoGp_cxIiz93YXOV73KMp1MfvhKY3OT7hzl5IxKb7wFXsLnFfIkWJfO6td4ZfcKxlm3GlkEJEm6YzHZVyK_WSOBMQizE4gm0qL1he8zFkU-_kzyNxYtlkJQv5T3s=&c=jttVEhTR1mnpB3Jo0N14PM7BIncs3E4-iBosLH88UuwrKLEjMTktjA==&ch=9is7RcoDTOhB-bPFRGmQS9sdQsdmBEngZg9FUBxTKL7uV4IC6TfH0w==)

Hi Peter,
Protecting Oak Flat has been a rallying cry for indigenous activists for years, and now the MAGA-led U.S. Forest Service has transferred ownership of Oak Flat to Resolution Copper, a British-Australian mining company.
Oak Flat is a place of great significance to the San Carlos Apache Tribe and Apache tribes across the western states.
Prayers, songs, coming-of-age rituals, and other ceremonies happen here.
Medicinal plants and sacred plants grow here.

subject: New York Times

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2450%2E135344%2EOkK6YE)

Elissa was featured in a recent article for the New York Times. It talks about the recent phenomenon of "prediction markets" and political insiders profiting off non-public information.
We've included the article below. Thank you for taking a few minutes to read up on this issue and what Elissa is doing about it.
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em251017&t=2&akid=2450%2E135344%2EOkK6YE)**

* * *

**NYT: Trump Says He Dislikes Prediction Markets.
His Family Invests in Them.**
When a U.S. soldier was indicted on Thursday on charges of using classified information to place prediction market bets, it seemed to confirm President Trump’s lament just hours before that “the whole world unfortunately has become somewhat of a casino.”
“I was never much in favor of it,” Mr. Trump said from the Oval Office, when asked about concerns that federal employees might be leveraging insider information on the prediction markets. “I don’t like it conceptually. It is what it is. I’m not happy with any of that stuff.”
Yet Mr. Trump and his family stand to profit from the very same industry.
The president’s publicly traded media company unveiled its own prediction market product last year. And the president’s eldest son, Donald Trump Jr., has ties to two of the industry’s top firms, including Polymarket, the platform that prosecutors say was used by the soldier for well-timed bets.
The result, ethics experts say, is a jarring juxtaposition between Mr. Trump’s public comments and his family’s private business.
While the president’s criticism of the prediction markets raised the prospect of new regulation, the reality is that little is likely to change. Last year, Mr. Trump’s administration backed away from enforcement efforts against Polymarket, and it is unclear whether regulators will adopt any new oversight measures.
“Presidential statements used to be the gold standard, but this is not true for President Trump,” Jeffrey A. Engel, founding director of the Center for Presidential History at Southern Methodist University, said.
“What he does is more important than what he says,” Mr. Engel said, adding, “I don’t think his comments will bother the prediction markets in the least.
Prediction markets, a fast-growing industry, allow consumers to place wagers on the likelihood of a future event, from cricket match scores to the release date of an album by the Canadian rap star Drake. But bettors can also weigh in on military and national security matters around the world. Some of those outcomes could be known or affected by a small group of decision makers, including those in Mr. Trump’s inner circle.
Mr. Trump made his remarks on Thursday, just hours before federal prosecutors in Manhattan charged Master Sgt. Gannon Ken Van Dyke, an Army Special Forces soldier who had helped capture Nicolás Maduro of Venezuela. Sgt. Van Dyke, prosecutors said, made more than $400,000 by betting on different outcomes related to Venezuela after learning of the operation.
He is not the only government employee suspected of placing well-timed bets on Venezuela and the war in Iran. There was a surge of suspicious trading related to the war last month. In response, Congress is considering legislation to limit government officials’ use of prediction markets, while officials in some states are also considering new regulations.
**Senator Elissa Slotkin of Michigan, the lead Democratic sponsor of legislation that would bar any public official from placing prediction-market bets using nonpublic information they learn in the course of their jobs, has warned about “operational risk” and threats to national security.**
**It remains unclear whether the Republican-led Congress will advance the bipartisan bill. Asked about the president’s son’s ties to Polymarket and Kalshi, Ms. Slotkin said in an interview last month that she feared the White House could throw up barriers to passing the bill by pressuring Republicans not to support it.**
**“It’s too politically dicey,” she said, adding: “There is not a single important issue of the day where I don’t feel the shadow of Trump and his sons.”**
In a statement, Davis Ingle, a spokesman for the White House, said: “President Trump has been crystal clear: While he seeks a strong and profitable stock market for everyone, members of Congress and other government officials should be prohibited from using nonpublic information for financial benefit. The only special interest that will ever guide President Trump is the best interest of the American people.”
There is no blanket prohibition on government employees’ placing bets on prediction markets, though prosecutors can still file fraud charges, as they did against Sgt. Van Dyke. He was also charged with unlawful use of confidential government information.
The White House issued a warning to staff last month against insider trading, amid a surge of suspicious trading on prediction markets, oil futures and stocks hinging on crucial moments in the conflict.
And the president’s remarks on Thursday served as another warning.
But his own family’s business interests could undermine the effectiveness of that message.
Last year, the publicly traded company that operates his social media platform, Truth Social, unveiled a new product called Truth Predict. The company, Trump Media & Technology Group, said the product would allow Truth Social users to trade prediction contracts “related to major events and milestones, such as political elections, interest and inflation rate changes.”
Truth Predict is not yet operational, according to a company spokeswoman, who said that the product was being developed and tested before launch.
A spokesman for Donald Trump Jr., who is a Trump Media board member, said he was not involved in the decision to create Truth Predict. The spokesman, Andrew Surabian, said that it was not a board-level resolution and that Donald Trump Jr. was not a part of the company’s day-to-day operations.
The younger Mr. Trump, however, has ties to both of the biggest prediction markets, Polymarket and its rival, Kalshi.
He is a paid adviser to Kalshi. And 1789 Capital, a venture capital firm in which Donald Trump Jr. is a partner, has invested in Polymarket. Mr. Trump is also an unpaid adviser to the company.
Mr. Surabian said that Donald Trump Jr.’s only involvement with prediction markets was to advise Kalshi and Polymarket on marketing strategies and to back Polymarket financially. He said that the president’s son did not trade on their platforms and that he never interacted with the federal government on behalf of any company he had invested in or advised.
There is no indication that Donald Trump Jr. will now seek to influence his father’s position on prediction markets. And it is unclear how firm the president’s position is.
Even his complaint that the world was becoming “somewhat of a casino” was an odd remark, coming from him. Mr. Trump spent years owning casinos, though they all eventually closed or changed hands.

* * *

As one of the few Senators who won a Senate race in the same state won by Trump, Elissa Slotkin is being asked to campaign for other Democrats in tough races across the country this election.
And while Elissa wishes we did not have to send another email asking you to contribute, that is what we have to do today.
The outcome of this election will determine whether we are able to put a check on President Trump during the final two years of his term. We have to take back the House and the Senate. And we need your help to get it done.
[**Can Elissa count on you to make a contribution of $10 or whatever you can afford before our April fundraising drive ends? It'd mean a lot to her as we fund her work traveling to help elect Democrats.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/1960?c0=ebs-em-26.gKZuWf&refcode=em251017&t=3&akid=2450%2E135344%2EOkK6YE)

| | | | | | Peter,

**Tomorrow, the Senate Judiciary Committee is expected to vote on House Bill 1793 and decide whether New Hampshire will continue forcing students, faculty, and staff onto defenseless college campuses or finally restore their constitutional right to protect themselves.**
After passing the House, the bill now needs strong support to advance to the full Senate without losing its core strength.

HB 1793, sponsored by Pledge Champion Representative Sam Farrington, prohibits public colleges and universities from banning the possession or carrying of firearms and non-lethal self-defense tools. It dismantles the failed policy of gun-free zones that have repeatedly proven to create soft targets rather than safe spaces.

A new op-ed co-written by Rep. Farrington in the New Hampshire Union Leader titled “[Gun-Free Campuses Are a Peril](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=5ecd57eedd&e=8c8e704ee6)” lays out the clear evidence.

**These zones do not stop determined criminals. They only disarm the law-abiding people who need protection most.** The piece makes a compelling case that maintaining the status quo puts lives at risk while a strong campus carry law would deter violence and empower responsible adults.

We understand some Senators may propose amendments. We are open to minor technical improvements that clarify the bill.

**What we will not accept, however, is any change that weakens its core purpose.**

The final legislation must deliver meaningful Second Amendment protections so that students, faculty, and staff on public campuses have the practical ability to defend themselves if the worst happens.

Your personal outreach has already moved the conversation. Now we need one more strong round of constituent pressure before tomorrow’s vote.

**Please contact the members of the Senate Judiciary Committee today and urge them to advance a strong, effective version of HB 1793 that truly protects people on campus.**
**📧 Sen. Bill Gannon –** [William.Gannon@gc.nh.gov](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=c3ce071617&e=8c8e704ee6)
**📧 Sen. Daryl Abbas –** [Daryl.Abbas@gc.nh.gov](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=f2cc50880c&e=8c8e704ee6)
**📧 Sen. Sharon Carson –** [Sharon.Carson@gc.nh.gov ](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=bf1a406bde&e=8c8e704ee6)

name: Kimberly Bretches
subject: Life behind bars could be his “reward”
body:
| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e995795/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvYkFNNHVLTnVSZw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA0Mjk/LbmNsejFCdFdyeg/qP2hpZHM9bmNSdlBTbDNwRk1EbHhscw/gafIGLw/s7q067fc4ce)
| | | Dear Friend, This is me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because NEXT MONTH, a police-hating, Soros-funded prosecutor will try to rip my husband away from our family and lock him up for life for doing his job. I should explain. For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off. And my husband made it home safe and sound. But what Chance didn’t know is that one of the beanbags he fired wound up hurting a rioter’s hand. And nearly TWO YEARS after my husband helped save our city from being burned to the ground, the county prosecutor decided to charge my husband with “aggravated assault by a public servant”—a charge punishable by life in prison. This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters. What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-police crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make police officers pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared, there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group that has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policeman's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? **[Would you help by sending a one-time gift to LELDF so this amazing group can defend my husband and the other good police officers who have been wrongly accused?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. _[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)_[__](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)__[_**So with that in mind, please know that any contribution -- be it $35, $100, $500 or even $1,000 -- is tax-deductible.**_ ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) But whatever you feel led to give, please send it back quickly. Chance’s trial starts next month. Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense. Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he’ll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison. He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle someday... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. _[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)_[__](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)__[_**So please, my friend, make your gift right away if possible.**_ ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) With this radical Soros-funded prosecutor on the warpath, _**[your gift of $35](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**_ \-- or any amount -- could be the difference between Chance clearing his good name... ...and spending the rest of his life behind bars. Thank you for reading my email today with such a generous spirit. I can never express how grateful I am to you -- in advance -- for helping my husband fight back.
---
With hope and thanks,
---
Kimberly Bretches
---
P.S. My husband Chance put his life on the line to keep our city safe from a rabid mob of violent protesters. Now life behind bars could be his “reward.” And to make things worse, we’re up against the deep pockets of a George Soros-backed prosecutor in court. We have very little time to act before Chance’s trial begins next month. Chance and I have four children—including a brand new baby that wasn’t born when the photo I sent you was taken. Please don’t let them grow up without their father. **[Thank you for any help you can send to LELDF today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
|
---
_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit leldf.org. And remember –Blue Lives Matter!_ © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | [www.PoliceDefense.org](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303
---
---
---

| | | | | [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O6sYZ2KTNj4ZCLwGr1pwPA2PXOeRNYxug2kAA6eFf4Y86LGmJIR5bABZAz7jUNYjUy2n4mLRm_sLTii1aAHJ3SBVXU8R_sFPKiUL3Ulf4wWx5eqASRchkAipkFaTSXP-2dMUd-_u18bjURbSGR3SFbj8IXNLJQQmQbxX6qdUY-xY4-jWO7EFWApNximY_LKOPJezkf95N2_iaIrGeBQIt-sQUfzQq-fc&c=EBkk-UGYaysarEqNMRcwChJ_SuIRojZf5aLgq6VKLRD1dkwDABVhZQ==&ch=QkQF1k-oAKFQWQIdDevWCSCimAhmvSgocSD75rRc7NzDjXVJBWASdg==)

Peter, Moments ago, the Supreme Court of the United States ruled in favor of stripping the Voting Rights Act of a key provision that guaranteed federal and state districts with minority representation.
In one fell swoop, they have given Republican legislatures across the Deep South the go-ahead to eliminate every majority black district. As many as 25 congressional seats as well as hundreds of state legislature seats, are now on the chopping block.
The Voting Rights Act brought about the end of Jim Crow. With this key provision removed, we are one step closer to its return:
---
| [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O6sYZ2KTNj4ZCLwGr1pwPA2PXOeRNYxug2kAA6eFf4Y86LGmJIR5bABZAz7jUNYjUy2n4mLRm_sLTii1aAHJ3SBVXU8R_sFPKiUL3Ulf4wWx5eqASRchkAipkFaTSXP-2dMUd-_u18bjURbSGR3SFbj8IXNLJQQmQbxX6qdUY-xY4-jWO7EFWApNximY_LKOPJezkf95N28KN6oCOkqExz8Ihg0jtEFn&c=EBkk-UGYaysarEqNMRcwChJ_SuIRojZf5aLgq6VKLRD1dkwDABVhZQ==&ch=QkQF1k-oAKFQWQIdDevWCSCimAhmvSgocSD75rRc7NzDjXVJBWASdg==)
---
The case that spurred this ruling began when a group of MAGA voters in Shreveport, Louisiana, claimed that Louisiana's Congressional maps, which complied with the Voting Rights Act, were "racist against white people."
The extremist GOP super majority in the Louisiana State House and Senate already has new maps ready to go that will eliminate nearly all black representation at the federal and state level. The only thing they were waiting on was this ruling, and now they've got it.
They want to see us go back to Jim Crow and lose our hard-fought representation. In November 2026, we have what could be our last chance to stand against this: the race for Louisiana's US Senate Seat.
My name is Jamie Davis, I'm a farmer and am the Democrat running for US Senate here in Louisiana. My family worked the same Louisiana delta that I farm today, first as slaves and later as sharecroppers. My message to MAGA is simple: we aren't going back.
Momentum is on our side here. The MAGA base is demoralized, and only a fraction of it is projected to vote in November. Louisianans are blaming Trump for rising living and fuel prices, and against all odds in a deep red Louisiana state House district, a Democrat just won by a landslide.
The time to make our last stand and elect Louisiana's first black Senator is now (or it may be never). [Please can you make a donation of whatever you can spare to capitalize on this once-in-a-lifetime moment and fuel our last-ditch effort for fair representation in Louisiana? body:
Legalized corruption: pharmaceutical edition
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2192%2E5691347%2E9j2-1q)

Hi. It’s Jon.
**My campaign’s creative team produced this video that breaks down Big Pharma’s stranglehold on Congress, and why American politicians have let drug companies rip off Americans for decades. You can watch it here:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ossoff-corruption-explainer](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-corruption-explainer.cXSe_Z&refcode=em260429-1-f&t=2&akid=2192%2E5691347%2E9j2-1q)**
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-corruption-explainer.cXSe_Z&refcode=em260429-1-f&t=3&akid=2192%2E5691347%2E9j2-1q)
**[WATCH NOW](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-corruption-explainer.cXSe_Z&refcode=em260429-1-f&t=4&akid=2192%2E5691347%2E9j2-1q)**
Donald Trump is a symptom of a deeper disease — a politics of legalized corruption that has infected the United States, especially since _Citizens United_.
I’ve seen it up close in Congress.
This is a system built to serve donors, protect incumbent Members of Congress, and exploit the public.
One of the clearest examples is the cost of prescription drugs.
For decades, drug companies have been ripping off Americans.
About one in three adults skips medications their doctor prescribes because they simply can’t afford them. Meanwhile, drug companies charge hundreds of times more than what it costs to produce these drugs.
How have they gotten away with it?
_Take this example:_
Back in 2003, Congress was creating Medicare Part D — a program intended to help seniors afford prescription drugs.
Big Pharma mobilized. They sent in an army of lobbyists and secured a key provision in the bill — _one that prohibited Medicare from negotiating drug prices._
Other wealthy countries negotiate lower prices for their citizens. _The United States banned it._
The result was predictable: American seniors ended up paying more than patients almost anywhere else in the world.
The congressman who championed the provision benefitting the industry, Billy Tauzin, left office right after it passed and took a job leading one of the industry’s most powerful lobbying groups, making over $2 million a year.
_From a humble Congressman straight to running an industry lobby shop for $2 MILLION A YEAR!!_
This is how our system has worked for a long time.
But it doesn’t have to. And it doesn’t always.
In 2022, I helped pass legislation that began to break the drug companies’ grip on Congress.
For the first time, Medicare can now negotiate drug prices. Out-of-pocket costs for seniors are capped at $2,000 a year. And insulin is capped at $35 a month for millions of Americans.
That doesn’t mean the problem is solved. But it proves that with enough political will, things can change for the better.
**This system can be changed when there’s the will to change it.**
If we can break the grip of corruption, we can build a politics that actually meets people’s needs instead of serving the wealthy and well-connected.
That’s a fight we have to win.
Because this matters so much, my campaign’s creative team put together a video that breaks it down. [**Please take a look, and then, pitch in if you can to support my reelection campaign.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-corruption-explainer.cXSe_Z&refcode=em260429-1-f&t=5&akid=2192%2E5691347%2E9j2-1q)
**[WATCH NOW](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-corruption-explainer.cXSe_Z&refcode=em260429-1-f&t=6&akid=2192%2E5691347%2E9j2-1q)**
Thank you. More soon.
Jon Ossoff

subject: I will never give up on our country

body:
This country has given me too much, and I’ll never be able to repay that debt.
#

Friend,
It’s hard to believe what happened over the last several months.
It didn’t stop when Trump called for me to be hanged. It didn’t stop when Pete Hegseth threatened me with a court-martial, either. It didn’t stop when the Department of Justice announced they were investigating me, or when the Department of Defense announced the same.
They even came after the rank I earned through 25 years of military service — all for saying things the president didn’t like to hear.
It would be easy to see all that and feel like this isn’t the country you grew up in. That Trump’s changed things too much, and there’s no coming back.
But friend, I really hope you haven’t given up. I certainly haven’t.
This country has given me too much, and I’ll never be able to repay that debt. I still believe in the United States of America, and there’s no chance in hell that somebody like Trump is going to stop me from serving the people of this nation. None.
Trump and Hegseth thought all of that would shut me up. They could not have been more wrong.
And if you’re willing to join me as we gear up for the most important midterm election of our lives, please:

# We will dethrone the mainstream media, but we need your help!
### Support PolitiBrawl by becoming a paid subscriber today:
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..x2ujUnjcEB5fZt8vav1yi-XkAwjbxWHQWKHA3XZbtQQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=195856231)
* * *
President Trump said something profound immediately after another left-wing radical tried to kill him on Saturday night: "The most impactful people, the people who do the most, they're the ones who they go after."
This is undeniably true. Trump is a force of radical change, a man of action seeking to disrupt the Washington D.C. establishment's favorite game: screwing over the American people in the pursuit of power.
So why did a teacher from California feel compelled to take action in this way? Certainly he wasn't a member of the establishment trying to retain his political power, but he was one of the millions of Trump-deranged "activists" ready to do the bidding of the elites after consuming thousands of hours of hyperbolic media rhetoric villainizing President Trump to the maximum and beyond.
Based on his manifesto, he truly believed Trump is a monster who needed to be stopped at all cost.
Wherever did he get that idea?
The left-wing media machine is an assembly line of hate and hysteria. It's funny to see so many people who consider themselves the educated six-figure earning do-gooders of society so easily manipulated by pretentious snobs working for once- respected news organizations still trying to cling to their respectability for dear life.
**This is why we exist. PolitiBrawl has launched a crusade to defeat the corporate media at their own game once and for all. We are patriots writing for patriots! You can help us by subscribing here and becoming a paid member of our Substack:**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..x2ujUnjcEB5fZt8vav1yi-XkAwjbxWHQWKHA3XZbtQQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=195856231)
The corporate media, perhaps excluding Fox News and much of Rupert Murdoch's empire, was built to protect the establishment. And once they realize they have been losing the trust, hearts and minds of millions of Americans that once tuned in, they decided to juice ratings while discrediting a populist threat to the political status quo by going all in on negative Trump coverage.
Once you've evoked Hitler, fascism and the KKK, there's nowhere to go from there. You have pulled the fire-alarm of American political discourse and your millions of viewers believe that there is a fire that needs to be put out immediately. Cole Allen, the alleged White House Correspondents Dinner shooter was likely one of these people, dutifully acting accordingly to the fire drill the media had pulled, telling him that America was about to be destroyed by Donald Trump. Telling him that returning to reasonable border control and enforcing immigration law was evidence that a new holocaust was on the horizon. Or that the Iran War was the beginning of World War three, as if nearly every president in the past 30 years hasn't engaged in similar regional military conflicts.
The most striking thing about Allen's manifesto is that it doesn't sound like the ramblings of a psychotic killer, it sounds like the worldview of so many leftists who make it their life's occupation to hate Donald Trump. He sounds like everyone at the "No King's" protests, or those lining up in the streets of Minneapolis to impede ICE officers from doing their jobs, or Democrat politicians who have called Trump fascist and a "threat to democracy," or even the talking heads on certain TV networks and in certain newspapers who echo this baseless message.
### **We will never stop exposing their lies! Support us by becoming a paid subscriber today:**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..x2ujUnjcEB5fZt8vav1yi-XkAwjbxWHQWKHA3XZbtQQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=195856231)
Allen's words sound very familiar to anyone who has spent time consuming left-wing media. The only difference between him and all those previously mentioned is that he decided to take action to address the existential emergency he believes to be at hand.
Trump was right, it's those who are actually moving the needle who are the most at risk. If he was an impotent puppet of the establishment (like Joe Biden) there would be no reason to remove him by any means necessary. He is The Man in the Arena, as President Theodore Roosevelt famously put it. MS NOW: ‘The largest investment ever’: DNC launches voter registration drive [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=042926_1&amount=30]
The 2025 elections showed us a valuable truth, folks: Voter participation is increasing in all the right ways.
Voter registration activity increased across the country. According to the team at National Voter Registration Day, New York recorded more registrations for their 2025 events than in 2024, and California saw similar increases. Earlier this fall it looked like voter participation was going to make a real jump, even in a so-called "off-year".
Then Election Day came. New Jersey had more voters turn out for a gubernatorial election than they had in 20 years. Crucial counties in Pennsylvania saw their highest turnout levels in almost 15 years. New York City reached a turnout percentage unseen in over five decades.
We can drive even higher levels of participation when voters understand the stakes and feel like their vote matters , just like it did last November. That's why our voter registration efforts are so important, and why we work on it all year long.
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or more today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=042926_1&amount=30]

The key is getting young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights across the country -- to see the importance of voting now more than ever. Pundits in Virginia said they could have called the election results when they saw the first turnout numbers from the major college campus locations around the state. That's the kind of impact these young voters can have.
Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The upcoming midterm election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.
New voter registration -- at a cost to us of just about $3 per new voter -- can be game-changing. clean_body: There is so much going on in America these days and I appreciate the opportunity to chat with so many interesting people and continue our conversation about how to heal America| | | Peter, I don't know about you, but 2026 is going by fast for me. It's hard to believe we're nearly to May. There is so much going on in our country these days and I appreciate the opportunity Substack provides to share my conversations with so many interesting people continuing our discussions about how to heal America. In this message, I’m sharing some recent interviews from my Substack page below. Like all of my interviews, these conversations are meant to be a place where you’ll hear fair, honest, and direct thinking from people who truly know the subject, without talking points or ideological spin. As always, , it would be welcomed! The money we raise goes directly into paying for the tools that allow me to share these conversations with you! Thank you for your ongoing support! -John | | | | | While I don't enjoy asking for donations, it's a necessary part of our effort to fight for a better America. _**Faith. Family. Freedom.**_

The Left is doing _everything_ they can to tear it all down. But I didn’t come to Washington to play games. I came to fight for the people who feel forgotten, overlooked, and ignored.

From securing the border to protecting our kids and defending our way of life—I’m in this for the long haul.

**This fight isn’t easy, but it’s worth it. And I’m not going anywhere.**

Will you stand with me?

** Ending freeloading and putting patients first **By Bobby Jindal & Hannah Anderson
---
The Trump administration’s Great Healthcare Plan marks a shift to prioritize American patients above systems, proposing actionable reforms to realign healthcare around patient needs. Congressional support through a future reconciliation package can cement this patient-first direction.

For decades, the American healthcare system has relied on giant systems to manage and pay costs. As a result, healthcare now consumes nearly one-fifth of the economy and costs up to $15,000 per person each year. Over time, government priorities shifted from patient advocacy to supporting bureaucratic programs and increasing government involvement in every aspect of healthcare spending and decision-making. Combined, these trends have created a system where patients come last. Trump’s Great Healthcare Plan seeks to alter that equation.

Rather than follow the example of his predecessor, Trump called for an end to the Obamacare subsidies to health insurance companies and directed those dollars to the patient instead. Ninety-three percent of Affordable Care Act enrollees receive federal subsidies, according to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). Congress can shift the requirements in the tax code to allow these tax credits, which go from the Treasury to insurance companies, to be given to patients, giving them more flexibility and control over how they spend their health dollars. [**Finish reading at WashingtonExaminer.com**](https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/restoring-america/courage-strength-optimism/4544805/ending-freeloading-putting-patients-first/\\)

body:
But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down.

| | | | Dear Friend,This is me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches.
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkU1u2zAQhU9D7Wjwz2S40CKurGzsojCCdElQw5FNlJQEinLQ2xcO4gN0OQ_fDPDN-312Zx9TnK4_fca21NGV1X3izd_xjuVvirUmrDFjnT1UJ5jQlCkq7IPjTWgDBM-hwZYbY5TR2ojm1oIWwMfg7SDQDMywUWvOXvjA1B4Cmia2j1NMCcv3kjO700oYrVngXMrBWiCK-YSl7gou25Ai-Kn69c84F8AdzLlJ7a3WZSXylYieiH5F2Aru_IRhrg-CiD5hCiMR_eKtgb0XPFCtDVAVrKVeKaD4stcoVdCogMh-q9mt81YAiewO3Ru9HD-I0I84Y4hbJrI7nr8T8Hnx8ToR2X3LGHfo3tzpeOp69-Nw4uev-XL8cL9e6eW9fy7OU8WpEtld3nv6fERT2rB8xpTiqg1R7Jp9TF-q9f-LubfiXwAAAP__lraWbQ)
---
This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because NEXT MONTH, a police-hating, Soros-funded prosecutor will try to rip my husband away from our family and lock him up for life for doing his job.I should explain.For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off.And my husband made it home safe and sound.But what Chance didn’t know is that one of the beanbags he fired wound up hurting a rioter’s hand.And nearly TWO YEARS after my husband helped save our city from being burned to the ground, the county prosecutor decided to charge my husband with “aggravated assault by a public servant”—a charge punishable by life in prison.This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters.What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-police crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make police officers pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared, there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group that has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policeman's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? **[Would you help by sending a one-time gift to LELDF so this amazing group can defend my husband and the other good police officers who have been wrongly accused?](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkU1u2zAQhU9D7Wjwz2S40CKurGzsojCCdElQw5FNlJQEinLQ2xcO4gN0OQ_fDPDN-312Zx9TnK4_fca21NGV1X3izd_xjuVvirUmrDFjnT1UJ5jQlCkq7IPjTWgDBM-hwZYbY5TR2ojm1oIWwMfg7SDQDMywUWvOXvjA1B4Cmia2j1NMCcv3kjO700oYrVngXMrBWiCK-YSl7gou25Ai-Kn69c84F8AdzLlJ7a3WZSXylYieiH5F2Aru_IRhrg-CiD5hCiMR_eKtgb0XPFCtDVAVrKVeKaD4stcoVdCogMh-q9mt81YAiewO3Ru9HD-I0I84Y4hbJrI7nr8T8Hnx8ToR2X3LGHfo3tzpeOp69-Nw4uev-XL8cL9e6eW9fy7OU8WpEtld3nv6fERT2rB8xpTiqg1R7Jp9TF-q9f-LubfiXwAAAP__lraWbQ)** You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. with that in mind, please know that any contribution -- be it $35, $100, $500 or even $1,000 -- is tax-deductible.**_ ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkU1u2zAQhU9D7Wjwz2S40CKurGzsojCCdElQw5FNlJQEinLQ2xcO4gN0OQ_fDPDN-312Zx9TnK4_fca21NGV1X3izd_xjuVvirUmrDFjnT1UJ5jQlCkq7IPjTWgDBM-hwZYbY5TR2ojm1oIWwMfg7SDQDMywUWvOXvjA1B4Cmia2j1NMCcv3kjO700oYrVngXMrBWiCK-YSl7gou25Ai-Kn69c84F8AdzLlJ7a3WZSXylYieiH5F2Aru_IRhrg-CiD5hCiMR_eKtgb0XPFCtDVAVrKVeKaD4stcoVdCogMh-q9mt81YAiewO3Ru9HD-I0I84Y4hbJrI7nr8T8Hnx8ToR2X3LGHfo3tzpeOp69-Nw4uev-XL8cL9e6eW9fy7OU8WpEtld3nv6fERT2rB8xpTiqg1R7Jp9TF-q9f-LubfiXwAAAP__lraWbQ) But whatever you feel led to give, please send it back quickly.Chance’s trial starts next month.Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense.Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he’ll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison.He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle someday... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. clean_body: But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. | | | | Dear Friend,This is me and my husband, Officer Chance Bretches. This photo used to be one of my favorites. Now looking at it makes me cry. Because NEXT MONTH, a police-hating, Soros-funded prosecutor will try to rip my husband away from our family and lock him up for life for doing his job.I should explain.For nearly 13 years, Chance has been a decorated police officer with the Austin, Texas Police Department. But in May of 2020, our lives were turned upside down. You probably remember what it was like in our country after George Floyd. Violent, fiery anti-police protests were sweeping through cities. Every step of the way, they were cheered on by radical politicians, Soros-funded prosecutors, and the Mainstream Media who lied to us and said, with a straight face, that these riots were "mostly peaceful." It was especially bad here in Austin, Texas. For three nights in a row, angry, anti-cop mobs rampaged through downtown, smashing windows, burning police cars, and looting stores. The crowd attacked officers like my husband who were trying to keep the peace, pelting them with rocks, bricks, and even lit fireworks. On the third night, things got even worse. Protestors shut down interstate, and a crazed mob surrounded Police Headquarters. Chance and his fellow officers knew that if they didn't restore order quickly, the headquarters, and maybe even the entire city, might burn to the ground. Following their training, they fired non-lethal weapons – the same "beanbag guns" that police have used for years to break up riots – to stop the violence before it got out of hand. The mob slunk off.And my husband made it home safe and sound.But what Chance didn’t know is that one of the beanbags he fired wound up hurting a rioter’s hand.And nearly TWO YEARS after my husband helped save our city from being burned to the ground, the county prosecutor decided to charge my husband with “aggravated assault by a public servant”—a charge punishable by life in prison.This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where lawless thugs who fling rocks at police and try to burn our city to the ground get off scot-free...while law-abiding officers get criminal charges and face life in prison for following their training and breaking up a mob of rioters.What are cops like my husband supposed to do when faced with this kind of out-of-control violence?! When Chance told me about the charges, my emotions went from disbelief to anger to despair...and back again. But it all started to make sense when we learned that the prosecutor in this case owes his election to a wad of campaign cash from none other than radical Leftist billionaire George Soros. That was when I realized that the anti-police crowd is trying to get revenge on my husband. They don't care if my husband is innocent. They'll do everything in their power to make police officers pay. It makes me wonder why anyone would ever sign up to join law enforcement these days. But nearly 13 years ago, my husband did. And he did it because helping innocent people is in his blood. His brother is a firefighter. His dad is a 34-year police veteran. My husband is a youth leader at our church and plays guitar in the worship band. He's served on mission trips -- planting churches, planning vacation Bible schools, and sharing the Gospel. And he's done his job as a police officer with honor and dignity, without a single mark against his record. Chance put his life on the line to protect our city from a violent, unhinged mob... ...and life behind bars could be his "reward." Even if my husband's good name is cleared, there is no way we could hope to pay the mountain of legal bills. Thankfully, by God's grace, there is one group that has stepped up to help us -- the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know that their record has made them a policeman's best friend. Jason Johnson and the LELDF board organize and fund the successful legal defense of good cops wrongly charged for crimes -- like my husband. LELDF hires the best attorneys and secures expert witnesses who will testify to the truth -- without being influenced by political paybacks. And now they've agreed to help Chance. My friend, you've read my letter this far so I'm going to ask as boldly as I can: Will you help Chance, too? You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. They rely entirely on the generosity of kind-hearted folks like you to defend the men and women in blue who defend us. But whatever you feel led to give, please send it back quickly.Chance’s trial starts next month.Our legal team needs to be working day and night getting ready for his defense.Because if Chance is found guilty... ...he’ll spend every wedding anniversary, birthday, and Christmas for the rest of his life in prison.He won't be able to take our sons to football games or teach them how to drive... He won't be able to walk our daughter down the aisle someday... I can't bear the thought of life without him. And I know what happens to former police officers when they get locked up with thousands of criminals. My only hope of saving him today is good-hearted patriots like you. With this radical Soros-funded prosecutor on the warpath, \-- or any amount -- could be the difference between Chance clearing his good name... ...and spending the rest of his life behind bars. Thank you for reading my email today with such a generous spirit. I can never express how grateful I am to you -- in advance -- for helping my husband fight back. With hope and thanks, Kimberly Bretches P.S. My husband Chance put his life on the line to keep our city safe from a rabid mob of violent protesters. Now life behind bars could be his “reward.” And to make things worse, we’re up against the deep pockets of a George Soros-backed prosecutor in court. We have very little time to act before Chance’s trial begins next month. Chance and I have four children—including a brand new baby that wasn’t born when the photo I sent you was taken. Please don’t let them grow up without their father. | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit leldf.org. And remember –Blue Lives Matter! © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303 Pop Acta Media | Republican Task Force PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

name: Tim Kaine
subject: Trump can’t pull us out of NATO
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026]
Derek,
Donald Trump is at it again — throwing another anti-NATO temper tantrum and threatening to pull the United States out.
Earlier this month, as the alliance marked its 77th anniversary, Trump called NATO a "paper tiger" and renewed his threats to abandon it.
His reason? He's furious that our NATO allies won't join his ill-advised war of choice in Iran — a war he launched without even consulting Congress.
But here's the thing: Trump’s hands are tied. He can’t unilaterally withdraw from NATO — I made sure of that.
Back in 2018, I started working with the late Senator John McCain on legislation to prevent any president from unilaterally leaving the alliance. That bill was ultimately signed into law in 2024 with an overwhelming bipartisan vote, and it has Trump's own Secretary of State Marco Rubio's name on it alongside mine.
I've written about all of this in a new op-ed for TIME magazine, and I hope you'll take a moment to read it. [https://time.com/article/2026/04/08/leaving-nato-would-be-national-self-sabotage/]
NATO is an indispensable force for democracy and peace. It protects our national security, deters our adversaries, expands our global reach, and has helped keep the peace for nearly eight decades. Here in Virginia, we're proud to be home to NATO Allied Command Transformation, where U.S. servicemembers train side by side with allies every single day.
Trump can throw his temper tantrums, but attempting to withdraw from NATO, or destroy it by other means, makes America and the world much less safe.
It’s up to Congress to reassert itself as a coequal branch of government and for Republicans and Democrats to work together to reject Trump’s acts of national self-sabotage.
I won't stop fighting to protect this country and our alliances from Trump's reckless actions. Thank you for standing with me.
—Tim
Tim Kaine
U.S. Senator for Virginia
