name: Wes Moore
subject: Saying goodbye
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1337%2E1086043%2EtQsgtE)
This is a longer email about saying goodbye, Peter, but if you don’t have time to read through, I would deeply appreciate **[a contribution to power our campaign before our end-of-month deadline tomorrow.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260429-1.x1husa&refcode=em-20260429-1&t=2&akid=1337%2E1086043%2EtQsgtE)**
After nearly a century of operation, Valley Forge Military Academy — the place where I went to school and grew from an angry, complicated child to a confident young man — will be closing.
When my mother first sent me to the Forge, she saw military school as a last resort in response to a seemingly endless chain of misbehavior, both at home and at school. At age 11, I’d already felt handcuffs on my wrists. **I was not on a path to success.**
There was no overnight miracle when I started school there, but slowly, things changed. I learned about honor, code, and service. I started to take an interest in campus life, academics, and leadership positions — and I rose up the ranks and became a first captain in command of around 800 cadets.
After graduation, I went on to study at Johns Hopkins and Oxford, deployed to Afghanistan with the 82nd Airborne Division, ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country, and now, I serve as the 63rd governor of Maryland _and the first Black governor in the history of my state._
What saddens me most isn’t losing a place I once called home. My memories will forever live on with me.
**It saddens me that other young men like me will have one fewer avenue to challenge themselves and build their own pathway to success.**
Peter, at a time where our young men and boys are falling behind and feeling isolated, we have to offer more paths for connection and engagement.
I know Valley Forge Military Academy did that for me, and I’m determined to find ways to do that for young Marylanders today.
That includes the **Maryland Corps and Service Year Option** — the first statewide program in the country to give high school graduates a year of paid, full-time community service on the path to college or a career.
We have to help young Marylanders find the thing that guides them on a pathway to success and that inspires them to serve. **[If you support that mission, I would appreciate a donation to keep me in the fight as Maryland's governor today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260429-1.x1husa&refcode=em-20260429-1&t=3&akid=1337%2E1086043%2EtQsgtE)**
Elevate,
Wes
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260429-1.x1husa&refcode=em-20260429-1&t=4&akid=1337%2E1086043%2EtQsgtE)
_Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform do not imply endorsement from the Department of Defense._

* * *

**[Volunteer »](https://support.wesmoore.com/a/volunteer?source=em-20260429-1)**

For years, Bitcoin has been described as unhackable. Its cryptography is strong, its network decentralized, and its track record resilient. But there is a growing conversation among engineers and researchers that deserves more public attention, not because it signals imminent collapse, but because it highlights a real and often misunderstood future risk: quantum computing.
The concern is not science fiction. It is rooted in the mathematics that secure Bitcoin itself.
Bitcoin relies on two major forms of cryptography. The first is hashing, which underpins mining and address generation. The second is digital signatures, specifically elliptic curve cryptography, which allows users to prove ownership of their coins. Today, both are considered secure against classical computers. But quantum computers operate under a different set of rules.
Using an algorithm known as Shor's algorithm, a sufficiently powerful quantum computer could theoretically derive a private key from a public key. That matters because Bitcoin transactions ultimately reveal public keys. If an attacker could reverse engineer the private key from that public information, they could spend coins that are not theirs.
This does not mean all Bitcoin would suddenly vanish. The risk is more specific and more nuanced. Only certain coins would be vulnerable at first, particularly those whose public keys are already exposed on the blockchain. This includes some early Bitcoin addresses and cases where users have reused addresses. Newer address formats are more protective because they keep the public key hidden until the moment a transaction is made.
Even then, the attack is not as simple as pressing a button and draining the network. Timing would matter. An attacker would need to derive a private key quickly enough to interfere with a transaction before it is confirmed. That requires a level of quantum computing power that does not exist today.
And that is the key point. The threat is real, but it is not immediate.
Experts across academia, government, and industry generally agree that cryptographically relevant quantum computers are still years away, though estimates vary widely. Some projections suggest decades. Others argue it could arrive sooner if breakthroughs accelerate progress. The uncertainty is part of the challenge.
What makes this issue worth paying attention to now is not the likelihood of a sudden attack, but the scale of preparation required. Upgrading Bitcoin's cryptography is not as simple as updating an app. It would require coordination across developers, miners, exchanges, and millions of users. It would also require moving funds to new address types designed to resist quantum attacks.
There are already early discussions within the Bitcoin development community about how such a transition could happen. Proposals for post quantum cryptography exist, and standards bodies like the National Institute of Standards and Technology have begun approving new algorithms designed to withstand quantum attacks. But no final path has been adopted for Bitcoin, and any change will involve tradeoffs in security, efficiency, and compatibility.
The cold wallet question also illustrates the complexity. Many people assume that storing Bitcoin offline makes it immune to future threats. Cold storage protects against hacking through the internet, but it does not change the underlying cryptography. If a public key is exposed, the theoretical quantum risk applies regardless of whether the private key is stored online or offline.
None of this is a reason for panic. It is a reason for awareness.
Bitcoin has faced technical challenges before and adapted over time. But quantum computing presents a different kind of problem. It is not about a bug or a vulnerability that can be patched quickly. It is about a fundamental shift in computing power that could eventually undermine the assumptions Bitcoin was built on.
The responsible approach is neither dismissal nor alarmism. It is education and preparation. Understanding where the risks lie, how they might develop, and what steps may be needed in the future is far more useful than assuming either that Bitcoin is perfectly safe or that it is doomed.
In the end, the conversation about quantum computing is less about whether Bitcoin survives and more about how it evolves.

# WEDNESDAY, APRIL 29, 2026
---
**Dear Flyover Reader,** Have you seen the headlines about the collapse of legacy media? Here's what just happened in the last few weeks alone:
* NPR just received an $80 million gift from Connie Ballmer, wife of former Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer--the largest single donation from a living donor in NPR's history--just to stay afloat.
* _The Standard_ (a major London newspaper) went from 75 employees to 16, with The Independent absorbing what's left.
* Bauer Media Group--the publisher behind hundreds of radio stations--announced a restructure that could cut 30% of its publishing staff.
* Conde Nast, publisher of _Vogue_ , _The New Yorker_ , and _Wired_ , is shuttering several publications.

This isn't a rough patch. This is the long-overdue consequence of years of broken trust. Gallup's most recent data shows trust in mass media has hit an all-time low--lower, in fact, than Americans' trust in politicians. Think about that for a second. The institutions that were supposed to hold power accountable are now trusted less than the people they cover. CNN, The New York Times, The Washington Post, NPR--these aren't neutral arbiters of facts anymore, and the American people know it. Their bias isn't a secret. It's a business model. And that model is failing. _The Flyover_ was built on a different belief: that the American people are smart, and they deserve news that delivers the facts without telling them how to think. That belief is working. In the past year, we've grown by nearly 2 million readers. We've launched multiple new state editions. We started a podcast. We now reach 4.5 million readers every morning and 1.4 million viewers a month on YouTube--and we're still growing. While legacy media is shrinking, the demand for honest, fact-first journalism has never been higher. We're meeting that demand every single day, seven days a week, without bias and without an agenda. But here's the honest truth: doing this well isn't free. _The Flyover_ will always be free to read. That's a promise. But delivering trustworthy, independent news to millions of Americans every morning takes real resources--real people, real work, every single day. Today, I'm asking you to join us. If T _he Flyover_ is part of your morning routine--if you've come to count on us for news you can actually trust--would you consider making a special gift to support our mission? Every American deserves a safe, dignified and affordable place to call home. |
---
Peter — I recently spent a great afternoon at Lands End 2 with community leaders in the Lower East Side talking about how we can improve Section 8 housing and advocate for affordable housing across New York. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130398928/617629941/-1870630518?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260429_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ODRjMmM3ZC1lNDQzLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8iuW_vH1WxN_MrA0u9-2qflDLfQw82NZYDzLZfPmk5E=)
_Dan meeting with Lands End 2 community leaders, April 2026_ It was a lovely day and a terrific meeting, but we were talking about a crisis. Too many of our neighbors are paying too much for apartments that aren’t safe or energy-efficient, and too many public-housing repairs are still waiting for funding. I’ve spent my time in Congress pushing real solutions — expanding the affordable housing supply, preserving Section 8, ensuring repairs are completed, and working to prevent New Yorkers from being displaced by higher rents. With your help, I led reforms to strengthen the Low Income Housing Tax Credit and pushed for the Brooklyn Marine Terminal redevelopment that will create thousands of homes, including deeply affordable units. I fought to secure $10.3 million for urgent NYCHA repairs and helped greenlight 5 World Trade Center, with a third of its units reserved as deeply affordable housing. And I’ve been fighting to make the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share so we can invest in working families — in housing, childcare, and public services that benefit everyone. **Your support keeps those fights going.** [_**Will you donate what you can to support my re-election campaign and help us keep up the work for our neighborhoods?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130398933/617629944/-1870630518?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260429_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ODRjMmM3ZC1lNDQzLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8iuW_vH1WxN_MrA0u9-2qflDLfQw82NZYDzLZfPmk5E=) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130398935/617629950/-1870630518?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260429_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ODRjMmM3ZC1lNDQzLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8iuW_vH1WxN_MrA0u9-2qflDLfQw82NZYDzLZfPmk5E=)

subject: Peter, let me reintroduce myself

body:
I'm looking for your personal endorsement
---
|
---
To unsubscribe from future communications, please click [here](https://act.davidcrowley.org/l/z7t4AVVUoQXr)

Peter, now that we've elected Chris Taylor to Wisconsin's Supreme Court, all eyes have shifted to our August election. This is a longer email, but I'm not going to ask you for money — [**just your grassroots endorsement.**](https://act.davidcrowley.org/l/9LdLTicO0WnR) **I wanted to take this chance to reintroduce myself: my name is David Crowley, I'm running for Wisconsin Governor, and there's a lot at stake for working people.**
---
[ **ENDORSE DAVID** ](https://act.davidcrowley.org/l/QZbi4bSrvJSg)
---
I know firsthand that when systems fail, families feel it first. My family certainly did.
---
| [ ](https://act.davidcrowley.org/l/z1o6E4voik4U)
---
My father worked as an electrician, and my mother worked in the service industry, while both battled addiction and mental health struggles. I spent many days at school wondering if I’d come home to find our belongings on the curb after another eviction, and I quickly learned what it was like to come home to no food in the kitchen and no heat in the house. **Those experiences shaped me, and they’re why I’ve dedicated my life to public service.** Today, as a husband and father of three, I’m laser-focused on what policy really means at the kitchen table.
---
| [ ](https://act.davidcrowley.org/l/fGGG3goM7sSC)
---
That means fighting for:
**➡️ Affordable, safe housing across Wisconsin****
****➡️ Health care that reaches people****
****➡️ Accessible childcare for Wisconsin families****
****➡️ Jobs and wages that build futures for working-class folks** **➡️ Expanding the middle class** My lived experience is how I lead, Peter. I understand that the challenges families face aren’t only policy debates, but they're the everyday realities so many folks in Wisconsin are facing. **That’s the mindset I’ve brought as a State Representative, as Milwaukee County Executive, and now as a candidate for Governor.** [**Peter , I’m ready to fight for a Wisconsin where every family has the chance to thrive—but I need your support to do it. Will you endorse our campaign today to help us kick off in the right way?**](https://act.davidcrowley.org/l/YrcyTFQUaMHj)
---
[ **ADD YOUR NAME** ](https://act.davidcrowley.org/l/mcNdxIlWmS4t)
---
Thank you, David Crowley
---
|
---
To unsubscribe from future communications, please click [here](https://act.davidcrowley.org/l/fRJAb60Jaa3Y)
---
|
---
| Like many Wisconsinites, David Crowley wasn’t fed by a silver spoon. Growing up, he never knew if he would come home from school to find his family's belongings on the curb due to another eviction, food in the kitchen, or the heat and lights still on. He learned early that hard work alone isn't always enough. That when systems fail, families feel it first.

[ ](https://act.davidcrowley.org/l/A90KDVrXC8jK)
That's why David Crowley’s campaign is built on one goal: **improving life for working Wisconsinites.**

BREAKING: The Supreme Court just handed down its ruling in Louisiana v.
Callais. Make no mistake — this is a gut punch to democracy.

By gutting Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act, the Court has stripped away
one of the last protections against gerrymandering and racially
discriminatory maps.

Communities of color who fought for decades to secure fair representation
are now at risk of being silenced, with up to 10 majority-Black seats
across the South potentially being redrawn out of existence and flipped
from blue to red.

Those who fought for a seat at the table could lose it entirely.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260429.qzZoAx&refcode=em20260429-61404&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=61404%2E1407376%2EMyz-QB ]If
you’re as outraged as we are, chip in $5 to Demand Justice
today to fight back.

This ruling doesn’t just impact Louisiana. Across the country, politicians
now have the green light to redraw districts to protect themselves,
entrench power, and block competition.

Elections will be engineered to favor incumbents even more. Voters won’t
choose their representatives — representatives will choose their voters.

And let’s be clear: the timing isn’t coincidental. This Court is handing
Trump and his allies a powerful tool to manipulate elections, cement
control, and rig the system in their favor.

By diluting minority representation, they’re paving the way for Trump to
shape the political landscape, protect his own power, and prioritize his
self-interest before a single vote is cast in the 2026 midterms.

Demand Justice PAC is fighting back — but we can’t do it alone. Every
dollar you give helps us challenge this radical Court, push for judicial
reform, and root out the corruption that lets Trump and his cronies
weaponize the courts against the American people.

clean_body: A historic opportunity| | | Patriot, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Patriot, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. Patriot, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. name: Eric Burlison for Congress
subject: Washington demonized DOGE. Americans cheered it on.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Eric Burlison for Congress]()
body:
They killed it because it worked. I'm fighting to bring it back.

| | | | | [|
---](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=1926d3e0a3&e=5f9dc01b8c)
| | Peter ,

**Washington demonized DOGE. Americans cheered it on.** That contrast tells you everything you need to know about who is on your side and who isn't.
When we were auditing federal agencies and asking real questions about waste, this Republican majority hit its highest approval rating of the entire term. The American people knew exactly what was going on. They watched it. They cheered it. For the first time in a long time, somebody in Washington was actually opening the books.
And the swamp couldn't stand it.
The press fought DOGE harder than they have fought almost anything in recent memory. Day after day, every cable channel, every front page, hit piece after hit piece. Why? Because the swamp fought it. And when the swamp tells the press to attack, the press attacks.
**Think about what that actually means.** It means the people in Washington who run our agencies, who write our regulations, who decide where your tax dollars go, were more upset about being audited than they were about wasting your money in the first place.
They did not want anyone looking. They did not want anyone asking questions. They did not want a paper trail. So they ran the auditors out of town, and the press helped them do it.
The job isn't done. Not even close.**My position is simple.** If your agency resisted efficiency reviews, don't come to my office looking for more of the taxpayer's money. You don't get a raise for stonewalling. You don't get a bigger budget for hiding the books. If you can't tell me where the last dollar went, I'm not giving you the next one.
And I am not letting this go. I am pushing to bring DOGE back. Not as a temporary commission. Not as something that can be killed the next time the swamp gets nervous. Permanent. A standing function of Congress and this White House. We know where the waste is. The work was already underway. We just need to finish it.
**But here's the truth about how Washington works.** The people who killed DOGE the first time are already lining up to kill it again. They are funding the candidates who will replace people like me with people who will look the other way. They have lobbyists. They have donors. They have a press corps that will write whatever they need written.
All I have is you.
House members run every two years. The campaign never stops. And if I lose this seat, every dollar of waste DOGE was about to expose stays buried. Every agency that resisted gets to keep doing what they were doing. Every bureaucrat who refused to answer gets their raise.
**I'm not going to stop fighting. But I need your help to stay in the fight.**[**> > STAND WITH ME — DONATE TODAY <<**](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=5bd0922321&e=5f9dc01b8c)
Even $10 or $25 makes a real difference. It tells me you have my back, and it helps me keep this seat so I can keep digging up the waste they've been hiding for decades.
Bring DOGE back. Make it permanent. Finish the job.Standing firm,

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Salt: The Most Essential Nutrient and Electrolyte in the World

Salt is life. It is woven into the fabric of our existence, our physiology, and even our history. Yet,
for decades, we have been bombarded with the notion that salt is harmful, that it leads to
hypertension, and that we should avoid it at all costs. I used to believe this too--until I read The
Salt Fix by Dr. James DiNicolantonio, which challenged everything I thought I knew about salt.
That book, along with my own research and experience as a fitness and nutrition expert, changed
my perspective entirely.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=195781529&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk1NzgxNTI5LCJpYXQiOjE3Nzc0ODIyNDYsImV4cCI6MTc4MDA3NDI0NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.kKESpmk221WL3SEojQAKaZVsRrwplGNvjPX9Tmk7Dfw)
Now, I want to set the record straight: Salt is not the enemy. In fact, it is one of the most crucial
substances for human life, athletic performance, and overall well-being. Let's dive deep into
what salt is, why it is essential for life on earth, and why it needs to be a priority in your diet.
What Is Salt and Why Is It Essential?

Salt, scientifically known as sodium chloride (NaCl), is a compound that plays a foundational
role in our bodies. It regulates fluid balance, supports nerve function, aids in muscle contractions,
and is crucial for maintaining blood pressure. Every cell in your body relies on the presence of
salt to function correctly.

When we eat salt, our bodies use the sodium component to facilitate electrical signals between
nerve cells, maintain proper hydration, and regulate the body's acid-base balance. Without
adequate salt intake, our energy levels plummet, our mental clarity diminishes, and our athletic
performance suffers.

The Medical Myths: Why Salt Was Demonized

For years, medical professionals and governmental dietary guidelines have warned us that salt
intake leads to high blood pressure and heart disease. But is that really true?
Modern research suggests otherwise. While some individuals with salt-sensitive hypertension
may need to moderate intake, for the vast majority of people, the real culprit behind heart disease
and chronic inflammation isn't salt--it's sugar. Excess sugar consumption leads to insulin
resistance, obesity, systemic inflammation, and arterial damage, which are far more concerning
than salt when it comes to cardiovascular health.

Studies have shown that individuals who consume adequate salt, rather than excessively
restricting it, have better metabolic function, improved insulin sensitivity, and reduced sugar
cravings.

The Chronic Dehydration Epidemic

Most people today walk around in a state of chronic dehydration, not because they aren't
drinking enough water, but because they lack adequate electrolytes--especially salt. Drinking
plain water without sufficient sodium can actually dilute essential minerals in the body, leading
to symptoms like fatigue, headaches, muscle cramps, and brain fog.

This is especially true for athletes, who lose significant amounts of salt through sweat.
Replenishing salt is vital to avoiding dehydration, maintaining performance, and preventing
cramps. I always tell my clients: When you sweat, you lose salt, just like when you cry. That
alone tells you how crucial it is to our bodies.

The Benefits of Proper Salt Intake

Adding the right amount of salt to your diet provides tremendous benefits:
 Improves Athletic Performance - Salt helps retain hydration and enhances muscle
function.
 Supports Weight Loss - Adequate sodium levels help regulate metabolism and curb
sugar cravings.
 Enhances Brain Function - Electrolytes like sodium are critical for nerve signaling and
cognitive function.
 Boosts Energy Levels - Sodium supports adrenal function, preventing fatigue and
burnout.
 Reduces Sugar Cravings - Salt helps balance blood sugar levels, reducing the body's
need for quick energy from processed sugar.

The Biblical and Historical Significance of Salt

Salt is deeply embedded in human history. The Bible references salt repeatedly, symbolizing
purity, preservation, and covenant. Jesus himself said, "You are the salt of the earth" (Matthew
5:13), emphasizing its importance not just for physical sustenance, but for spiritual significance.
In ancient cultures, salt was so valuable that Roman soldiers were sometimes paid in salt--a
practice that gave rise to the word salary. Wars have been fought over salt, and entire economies
were built upon its trade.

Beyond its spiritual and economic significance, salt also played a crucial role in food
preservation before refrigeration. By drawing moisture out of food, salt inhibits bacterial growth,
making it a natural method of keeping food fresh. Our ancestors survived harsh conditions
thanks to salt, and it continues to be a staple in traditional food preparation around the world.
The Best Salts to Use

Not all salt is created equal. While standard table salt is heavily processed and often contains
anti-caking agents and additives, natural salts provide a much richer mineral profile.

Some of my favorite salts include:
 Sea Salt - Rich in trace minerals and harvested from evaporated seawater.
 Celtic Salt - Known for its grey color and high mineral content, sourced from coastal
regions in France.
 Himalayan Pink Salt - Mined from ancient salt deposits in Pakistan, packed with
minerals.
 Red Hawaiian Salt - Contains volcanic clay, giving it a unique flavor and nutrient
profile.
 Black Lava Salt - Infused with activated charcoal for added detoxification benefits.

I've had the privilege of receiving salts from clients all over the world--Turkey, India, Paris,
Hawaii--each with its unique taste and texture. It's a testament to how salt connects cultures,
geography, and even personal experiences.

Salt and Fasting: Why You Need More When You Fast

During fasting, the body excretes more sodium because it is not getting it from food, particularly
carbohydrates, which typically provide a steady stream of salt. Therefore, replenishing
electrolytes during fasting is crucial for preventing fatigue, headaches, and muscle weakness.
I recommend adding a pinch of high-quality sea salt to water during fasting periods to maintain
electrolyte balance and prevent dehydration. It makes an immediate difference in energy levels
and overall well-being.

Conclusion: Embracing Salt as a Vital Nutrient

Salt is not the enemy--it's an essential, life-giving nutrient. Whether you're an athlete, someone
focused on longevity, or just looking to optimize your health, increasing your intake of high-
quality salt can dramatically improve your well-being.

As a surfer, I've always loved the taste of salt on my skin after being out in the ocean. There's
something deeply primal about it, a reminder that salt is in our blood, our sweat, and even our
tears. It's time to reclaim salt as the nutritional powerhouse it is, reject the outdated fear of it, and
embrace its benefits for a healthier, stronger, and more vibrant life.
Salt is life. Let's start treating it that way.

Salt isn't the enemy--sugar is... and your low-salt life might be quietly wrecking your energy and performance. | | | Apr 29 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Salt: The Most Essential Nutrient and Electrolyte in the World Salt is life. It is woven into the fabric of our existence, our physiology, and even our history. Yet, for decades, we have been bombarded with the notion that salt is harmful, that it leads to hypertension, and that we should avoid it at all costs. I used to believe this too--until I read The Salt Fix by Dr. James DiNicolantonio, which challenged everything I thought I knew about salt. That book, along with my own research and experience as a fitness and nutrition expert, changed my perspective entirely. Now, I want to set the record straight: Salt is not the enemy. In fact, it is one of the most crucial substances for human life, athletic performance, and overall well-being. Let's dive deep into what salt is, why it is essential for life on earth, and why it needs to be a priority in your diet. What Is Salt and Why Is It Essential? Salt, scientifically known as sodium chloride (NaCl), is a compound that plays a foundational role in our bodies. It regulates fluid balance, supports nerve function, aids in muscle contractions, and is crucial for maintaining blood pressure. Every cell in your body relies on the presence of salt to function correctly. When we eat salt, our bodies use the sodium component to facilitate electrical signals between nerve cells, maintain proper hydration, and regulate the body's acid-base balance. Without adequate salt intake, our energy levels plummet, our mental clarity diminishes, and our athletic performance suffers. The Medical Myths: Why Salt Was Demonized For years, medical professionals and governmental dietary guidelines have warned us that salt intake leads to high blood pressure and heart disease. But is that really true? Modern research suggests otherwise. While some individuals with salt-sensitive hypertension may need to moderate intake, for the vast majority of people, the real culprit behind heart disease and chronic inflammation isn't salt--it's sugar. Excess sugar consumption leads to insulin resistance, obesity, systemic inflammation, and arterial damage, which are far more concerning than salt when it comes to cardiovascular health. Studies have shown that individuals who consume adequate salt, rather than excessively restricting it, have better metabolic function, improved insulin sensitivity, and reduced sugar cravings. The Chronic Dehydration Epidemic Most people today walk around in a state of chronic dehydration, not because they aren't drinking enough water, but because they lack adequate electrolytes--especially salt. Drinking plain water without sufficient sodium can actually dilute essential minerals in the body, leading to symptoms like fatigue, headaches, muscle cramps, and brain fog. This is especially true for athletes, who lose significant amounts of salt through sweat. Replenishing salt is vital to avoiding dehydration, maintaining performance, and preventing cramps. I always tell my clients: When you sweat, you lose salt, just like when you cry. That alone tells you how crucial it is to our bodies. The Benefits of Proper Salt Intake Adding the right amount of salt to your diet provides tremendous benefits:  Improves Athletic Performance - Salt helps retain hydration and enhances muscle function.  Supports Weight Loss - Adequate sodium levels help regulate metabolism and curb sugar cravings.  Enhances Brain Function - Electrolytes like sodium are critical for nerve signaling and cognitive function.  Boosts Energy Levels - Sodium supports adrenal function, preventing fatigue and burnout.  Reduces Sugar Cravings - Salt helps balance blood sugar levels, reducing the body's need for quick energy from processed sugar. The Biblical and Historical Significance of Salt Salt is deeply embedded in human history. The Bible references salt repeatedly, symbolizing purity, preservation, and covenant. Jesus himself said, "You are the salt of the earth" (Matthew 5:13), emphasizing its importance not just for physical sustenance, but for spiritual significance. In ancient cultures, salt was so valuable that Roman soldiers were sometimes paid in salt--a practice that gave rise to the word salary. Wars have been fought over salt, and entire economies were built upon its trade. Beyond its spiritual and economic significance, salt also played a crucial role in food preservation before refrigeration. By drawing moisture out of food, salt inhibits bacterial growth, making it a natural method of keeping food fresh. Our ancestors survived harsh conditions thanks to salt, and it continues to be a staple in traditional food preparation around the world. The Best Salts to Use Not all salt is created equal. While standard table salt is heavily processed and often contains anti-caking agents and additives, natural salts provide a much richer mineral profile. Some of my favorite salts include:  Sea Salt - Rich in trace minerals and harvested from evaporated seawater.  Celtic Salt - Known for its grey color and high mineral content, sourced from coastal regions in France.  Himalayan Pink Salt - Mined from ancient salt deposits in Pakistan, packed with minerals.  Red Hawaiian Salt - Contains volcanic clay, giving it a unique flavor and nutrient profile.  Black Lava Salt - Infused with activated charcoal for added detoxification benefits. I've had the privilege of receiving salts from clients all over the world--Turkey, India, Paris, Hawaii--each with its unique taste and texture. It's a testament to how salt connects cultures, geography, and even personal experiences. Salt and Fasting: Why You Need More When You Fast During fasting, the body excretes more sodium because it is not getting it from food, particularly carbohydrates, which typically provide a steady stream of salt. Therefore, replenishing electrolytes during fasting is crucial for preventing fatigue, headaches, and muscle weakness. I recommend adding a pinch of high-quality sea salt to water during fasting periods to maintain electrolyte balance and prevent dehydration. It makes an immediate difference in energy levels and overall well-being. Conclusion: Embracing Salt as a Vital Nutrient Salt is not the enemy--it's an essential, life-giving nutrient. Whether you're an athlete, someone focused on longevity, or just looking to optimize your health, increasing your intake of high- quality salt can dramatically improve your well-being. As a surfer, I've always loved the taste of salt on my skin after being out in the ocean. There's something deeply primal about it, a reminder that salt is in our blood, our sweat, and even our tears. It's time to reclaim salt as the nutritional powerhouse it is, reject the outdated fear of it, and embrace its benefits for a healthier, stronger, and more vibrant life. Salt is life. Let's start treating it that way. Editorial comments expressed in this column are the sole opinion of the writer. Always consult a physician before starting an exercise or diet regime. name: Gary Sinise, American Veterans Center
subject: A historic opportunity to honor veterans this Memorial Day
body:
It’s Gary Sinise here.

| | |
---
Friend,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zodnu6v4c9ol9qvc9je2i74ns74abfur5pqboov8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
Friend, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. **Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you.** **[In light of America's 250th birthday and the special opportunity we have to honor veterans this year, will you chip in today to help support the parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7jq0aekgvrl0cuih7e8idaav4rq4ntqpvjfq7vo_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)**
---
[ **Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo2r7e42j8gu9shp6so17d8ms0e86br2t7g9dr88_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuvvkgn4rr3fl7caakqgkbcgengbe8vclbsi26e8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
[ **Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zep3e3mer97abqtaapqolkis912qqpqn4skuthu8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. _Bigger_ crowds. _More_ veterans. _More _young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zidva7r2vfddn2l441q9781to47lr0rdo21n39p8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ **But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded ****_entirely_**** by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country.** **[Friend, as we look ahead to this historic event, can I count on your generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z91ekfissecm38pfclf6mkc4k2u33c9g8i696kh0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs93jjt397795js7hgjv12p7jb2gdfql229epuk0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)**
---
[ **Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdc1l75ic5ph7112sadnofnrv7073pjohje2mgk8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl944sjftrvv78g4nq6kv8oe8676r9vmufor7i2g_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
| | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like:
---
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever.

* Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars.

* Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

---
But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. [**Please join me in support of the National Memorial Day Parade during America's 250th birthday with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or more right now.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvjluhjchl5i46dv2h3ldaa1mit87mgvvcjhi8r8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
[ **Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8dpgnl5gdhvgvtedmot967bm35vnar379lfvvmo_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. _And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get._ You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult.
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z78q2q8oibuk55mik8efoglr9aleqomqsf4mnem0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7u6k29n47001kuelk652h5ujj165u7eaoq0c8eo_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
| | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. _But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade._** ** **This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250****th**** birthday overlap. ** **[Will you join AVC and me in making a concerted effort to ensure these veterans are at this year's historic National Memorial Day parade to honor them one last time?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zecqlqt908hrhhtq4l8red1qapmgbbijfqnf0r70_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)**
---
[ **Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8ulmrauki5cq1bqkdfmdhk3v0qvqr1kne60e090_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaq93p6bd1d1ff1r8qfgtpjbml3j39pbtot7f320_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. **Friend, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. ** [**And please, if you're able, make a gift to fund the National Memorial Day parade right now during America's 250****th**** birthday.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh6vkheh6hf9c89vr5p8hfuvto0f71q9qsf56e90_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
Sincerely,

Gary Sinise
Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade
---
**P.S.** Friend, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. There's no better send-off we can give them than to make sure they're present to honor their fallen brethren during America's 250th birthday. **[Please join AVC and me today in making this event possible with your generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or whatever amount you can give.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8f2nrk5scon9n5ooshagtk957khidk2m31eku78_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)**
---
[ **Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zci19p93pftmkl5hl3nj24uispfedrlkalksnqb0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhso4rg7cjs5u9r2uai1q1frhiu9bt6er39hdglo_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---
[ **Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdfrirk23mu8ip87fcjl7qdaulhlchfon0qb5fco_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5ie6pj7cth2bs)
---

Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Friend, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. Friend, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. There's no better send-off we can give them than to make sure they're present to honor their fallen brethren during America's 250th birthday. The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today. A non-profit educational organization, the AVC and WWIIVC are funded solely through generous contributions from people like you. All contributions are tax-deductible. Friend, 60 years ago the Civil Rights Movement fought to finally end segregation and create a true American democracy that includes everyone. Martin Luther King Jr. and other activists led the passage of the Voting Rights Act to solidify new civil rights and protections.
**Today, our MAGA-extremist Supreme Court completely gutted the Voting Rights Acts and MLK’s legacy in a historically devastating decision.**
For decades, Black voters — who overwhelmingly vote for Democrats — have secured political representation in Congress thanks to the VRA’s protection of minority districts, especially in southern states that have historically disenfranchised people of color.
With today’s decision, SCOTUS has given Republicans a free pass to redistrict those majority-Black and even some majority-Hispanic districts out of existence, slicing up as many as 12 Democratic districts held by people of color and distributing those voters across white, Republican-majority districts.
Black communities in places like Memphis, New Orleans, Charleston, Birmingham, and more will see their representation in Congress completely erased. **This is a profound blow to our democracy and a direct attack at Democratic power by an illegitimate, MAGA-fied Supreme Court.**
As I write this message to you, I’m not going to pretend to have all the answers. But here’s what I do know: The best way Democrats can fight this is by taking up a popular agenda that offers real change for Americans, and taking that message to every state and every district across this country in pursuit of a massive victory that can break Republican gerrymanders.
**And yes: Democrats should fight fire with fire by taking back as many districts as we can in states where we control the Congressional maps.** We already saw this strategy work in California and Virginia. Now we must push more states to follow suit.
[**SCOTUS handed down a major setback for democracy, justice, and equality, but I’m not giving up. subject: Chris is endorsing Pedro Colón for Wisconsin Supreme Court
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Taylor for Justice
body:
Check out what she had to say >>
#
Friend, it's Team Taylor reaching out to share that Justice-elect Chris Taylor is enthusiastically endorsing Judge Pedro Colón for the open seat on the Wisconsin Supreme Court!
[](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/31?c0=pcolon-email.aPwg1i&amount=5&refcode=20250429_em_fr_b1_TCT_30_90_10_AllD&t=2&akid=1376%2E294397%2EWvqVEG)
In announcing her endorsement, Chris said:
"Pedro Colón is exactly the kind of justice Wisconsin needs on its Supreme Court," said Justice-elect Taylor. "His depth of judicial and life experience would be a welcome and important perspective to the court. Over his 15 years on the bench, he has proven to be a fair and impartial judge who treats everyone that comes before his court with dignity and respect. I have seen his work up close. I know his record. And I know he has the experience, the judgment, and the steady temperament the people of Wisconsin deserve on their highest court. I’m proud to endorse my friend, Pedro Colón and, next spring, I hope the voters of our state send him to serve with me on the Wisconsin Supreme Court.”
Chris has seen Pedro's work up close, she knows his judgment, and she knows the steady temperament he would bring to the bench that the people of Wisconsin deserve on their Supreme Court.
As you know, Supreme Court elections are important in Wisconsin, and we have the chance to REPLACE a far-right justice with a proven leader who will join Chris in actually representing Wisconsin values.
[**You probably remember that Chris faced millions of dollars of dark money from right wing billionaires – we know that Pedro will too. Will you help him get a head start by chipping in any amount today?**](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/31?c0=pcolon-email.aPwg1i&amount=5&refcode=20250429_em_fr_b1_TCT_30_90_10_AllD&t=3&akid=1376%2E294397%2EWvqVEG)

Team Taylor

**Don Lemon** and I went _all the way in_ on this one. What started as a conversation about Pam Bondi turned into something bigger--accountability, corruption, and the feeling that the system just isn't working the way it's supposed to. It got real. It got messy. And it got a little heated.

# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4589%2E898137%2EJ2QSWt)
It’s crunch time.
Getting Mallory McMorrow on the ballot is our best shot at winning Michigan’s Senate seat and shaking up the status quo in Washington.
Recent polling shows that voters support Mallory’s vision and resonate with her story. And when people hear about what she’s accomplished, she climbs straight into the lead over the extreme MAGA Republicans in this race.
[](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-april2026.vCnu4h&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20260429_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=4589%2E898137%2EJ2QSWt)
We’ve been everywhere lately — from brewery stops in Grand Rapids to coffee shops in Detroit to dog sled races in the U.P. — and the energy on the ground is incredible. People are packing into crowded rooms, fired up because they’re tired of the same old "status quo" politics. They want someone who actually gives a damn about Michigan families, not someone looking to score points for extreme MAGA donors.
But here’s the reality:**the Senate Leadership Fund, the largest GOP super PAC, has dropped $45 million into trying to flip Michigan.** We’ve made it this far without taking a single cent from corporate PACs, and we’re proud of that.
We have a real shot at winning this Senate seat, but only if we keep up our pace.

Yes, _that Ghislaine Maxwell. _
A convicted sex trafficker. A woman who helped facilitate the abuse of children — someone survivors fought for years to bring to justice.
And now some Republicans want to let her walk free.
**[Add your name: No pardon for Ghislaine Maxwell>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130404709/617651156/-1371203739?refcode=260429_RG_maxwell-pet-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZGNlMGY2OS1lZTQzLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8P65uS_Y4pnXRYWFd93_4sfnxLNHkOkONqdKu8dw7TA=&emci=f5af2b94-d443-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=7dce0f69-ee43-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=16877361)**
Survivors deserve accountability, not backroom deals. They deserve justice, not political bargaining. **And they deserve leaders willing to fight for them, no matter who it implicates.**
So while Republicans want to cut a deal to continue covering up for Donald Trump, I’m not backing down. I’m going to keep pushing for the full truth — no pardons, no favors, no exceptions.

#

**Hi, it’s Gabby Giffords. I wanted to make sure you saw this recent message from Jimmy Kimmel.**
As a victim of gun violence, I know what can happen if guns fall into the wrong hands. That’s why I am leading the fight to end the gun lobby’s influence in our politics, and why I am personally asking for you to donate $3 before our end-of-month deadline.
**[I hope you’ll read Jimmy’s message below, then rush a donation to help GIFFORDS PAC continue this work.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260429-1-expansion&t=1&akid=11434%2E3935704%2EsG2QJy)

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260429-1-expansion&t=2&akid=11434%2E3935704%2EsG2QJy)
---
Hi there, Jimmy Kimmel here.
I know you’re used to seeing me on your TV screen, but today I’m reaching out to you about an important topic close to my heart: _ending America’s gun violence crisis._
Gun violence isn’t always in the headlines, and it can be far too easy for us to go about our daily lives and forget that it’s happening each and every day. But for the families who now have empty seats at their dinner table — like the families who lost a child in Newtown, Parkland, or Uvalde — they can never, ever forget.
**[GIFFORDS is doing lifesaving work at the forefront of the gun safety movement, and I'm proud to be an ambassador for this incredible organization. Will you join me in supporting GIFFORDS PAC by making a contribution to support their work?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260429-1-expansion&t=3&akid=11434%2E3935704%2EsG2QJy)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260429-1-expansion&t=4&akid=11434%2E3935704%2EsG2QJy)**
Gun violence is a uniquely American epidemic. The leading cause of death for children in our nation is gun violence.
This is the only developed country in the world where this happens. We have to do something to change this.
Laws such as universal background checks, safe storage laws, and extreme risk protection orders would help ensure that guns can’t fall into the hands of people who shouldn’t have access to them. We call these laws common sense because that’s just what they are — common sense.
It is long past time for our representatives to do their job and truly represent the American people. The majority of Americans support commonsense gun safety legislation.
_**But instead, the Trump administration is focused on making guns even easier to buy and lining the pockets of his gun lobby allies._**
This is not a moment where we can sit back. We must be loud and use our collective voice to make a change. So please:
**[Will you make a commitment to ending our nation’s gun violence crisis by donating $3 to my friends at GIFFORDS PAC today? Your support is crucial.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260429-1-expansion&t=5&akid=11434%2E3935704%2EsG2QJy)

The Supreme Court just took a chainsaw to decades of civil rights progress

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130406487/617654327/-1080040549?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDljNmJhNS1mMDQzLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6g15kVv3UGaMP7rl1eb86_mFodjY1mj3h3Cz9U_lrfY=) Team, **The Supreme Court just voted to dismantle the section of the Voting Rights Act of 1965 that allows ALL people to be represented through fair electoral maps, regardless of the color of their skin.** This ruling will pave the way for Republicans across the country to rig the House maps for their own political power. The late Congressman John Lewis did not put his life on the line in 1965 to cross the Edmund Pettis Bridge in vain. He led a movement that brought fairness to our elections in search of a more perfect union. Today's ruling unravels decades of fairness where people get to choose their elected leaders, not the other way around. Too much is at stake right now. Whether it's through legislation, litigation, or agitation, now is not the time to back down. In light of the third (known) assassination attempt against President Trump, let us retire the slogan "see something, say something".
Ubiquitous after 9/11 and heard across the airwaves, at stadiums, in airports, for over 20 years "see something, say something" has served as both request and order to prevent another tragedy. Don't stand by idle when something seems amiss. Don't ignore clear warning signs. Take action. Do your part to prevent a possible tragedy. "Better safe than sorry" being the undertone.
However, the slogan is fundamentally flawed.
"See something, say something" presupposes a shared moral code, and we do not have one. Certainly no longer, if, in fact, we ever really did.
"See something, say something" presupposes civil society maintains the same basic principles of social order and cohesion, an objective understanding of good and evil, a recognizable and incompatible right juxtaposed against a clear and unmistakable wrong.
None of this is true now. Certainly no longer, if, in fact, it ever really was.
How do we ask "see something, say something" about Islamic radicals chanting "globalize the Intifada" when New Yorkers **[elected one](https://substack.com/redirect/f2be918d-9484-4c44-9756-79be6fea1ecf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of them as Mayor? How do we ask "see something, say something" about violent rhetoric from a Mosque calling for death of America when **[democrats](https://substack.com/redirect/c9d0f401-aa3c-4510-b259-514ea123e9e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** fundraise there? "No justice, no peace" was a radical expression, but now it is standard practice from Portland to Seatle to Kenosha to Ferguson to Occupy Wall Street to setting fire to Saint John's Church in Washington, DC.

* * *
We are not all guilty of political violence. Only the left is.

"You said Joe Biden is destroying this country!" I did, and he was. "You said Nancy Pelosi is evil!" I did, and she is. I do not for a second entertain the idea that this is language of violence or calls to violence, nor will I play the left's linguistic games so they can continue to incite violence against us.

I value my life too much. I value the truth even more.
The left loves violence. From Stalin to Mao to Cole Allen Thomas, the left embraces violence to get their way, not surprising from a political movement which celebrates abortion and fights for perverts to read stories to children. Mire yourself in evil and you render yourself incapable of seeing anything let alone saying anything, as nothing is distinguished.

Honor and courage.

Literally. = | | = Ever since we kicked off this campaign, I’ve shown up to all four corners of our state and everywhere in between. And I made the choice to get into this race on the early side, because I knew it would be important to make policy plans based on conversations with you — the folks I’m running to serve. That was the right approach because our state is facing a long list of issues. Too many Coloradans can’t afford their rent and cannot see buying a home in reach. The mental health crisis is knocking on our kids’ doors. All 64 counties are already feeling the effects of climate change. And the Trump administration has repeatedly tried to intimidate and bully our state into complying with their agenda — even when attacking us means breaking the law. subject: We’re furious, Derek.
body:
---
Derek, Today, with its decision in _Louisiana v. Callais_ , the Supreme Court gutted the core requirement of the Voting Rights Act to protect minority opportunity districts. **We’re _furious_ , and we know you are too.**[**If you’re ready to act, rush a $7 donation to the DNC to help us protect voting rights.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-scotus-rr-april-2026?refcode=em_20260429_6942_fr&amount=7&refcode2=6942_22930333_Iyrlvh&akid=6942%2E22930333%2EIyrlvh) With this ruling, the Court has opened the door to diluting Black, Latino, AANHPI, and Native American representation across the country, especially in the South, where Republicans have made clear they want to split the voting power of minority communities. **_This decision is a huge blow. Today is a dark day for America and for voters of color across the country — but we cannot let this decision slow us down, even for a minute.**_ Derek, this decision will make it harder to take back control of Congress. It will put a permanent scar on American democracy and impact election results for decades to come. This is a major step backwards in the fight for racial justice and fair representation. All of that is true, but so is this: **We are not backing down. Democrats will fight tooth and nail to ensure the voices of _all_ Americans are heard this November, and in every election after that.** Our lawyers work every day to protect voting rights in this country. As we speak, they are engaged in court battles with the Trump administration over their illegal attempts to access state voter rolls and to make it harder to register and vote. So while this decision is a major setback, we are not giving up. **We don’t have a choice; we _have_ to keep fighting. The future of our democracy depends on it.** [**Derek, if you’re still in this fight with us,_please_ consider giving $7 to the DNC today to help us continue our fight against the Trump administration, in court and on the ground. body:
With less than 24 hours left until the end of April, we’re facing our very first end-of-month fundraising deadline.
#
Peter,
When we launched Small Town PAC, we said it would be about rebuilding the places that built us — our schools, our local economies, and the sense of community that holds small towns together. The places that are so often forgotten on the national stage.
**Now, we’re putting that mission into action.**
With **less than 24 hours left** until the end of April, we’re facing our very first end-of-month fundraising deadline with one ambitious goal:
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260429.DV5A2e&amount=5&refcode=em20260429-557&t=1&akid=557%2E34582%2EvIJCyP)
This is our first test, and it will determine how quickly we can start making an impact at a time when it matters most. Our goal is more than just a number — it sets the foundation for everything we’re going to build together this election cycle and beyond.
**[If you’re able, chip in whatever you can today to become a founding donor to our movement before the month is over.](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260429.DV5A2e&amount=5&refcode=em20260429-557&t=2&akid=557%2E34582%2EvIJCyP)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260429.DV5A2e&amount=5&refcode=20260429-557&t=3&akid=557%2E34582%2EvIJCyP)**
Small Town PAC is focused on finding and lifting up a new generation of leaders: teachers, nurses, veterans, and working people who know their communities best because they’ve lived in them, worked for them, and fought for them.
With the resources we raise right now, we can start:
* Recruiting candidates in overlooked districts,
* Building early infrastructure to support campaigns,
* Amplifying a message that puts working communities first.

There are so many people in these communities who are ready to step up and lead. What’s been missing is the support to help them get there.
**That’s where we come in.**
This first end-of-month deadline is our chance to prove our movement has real momentum behind it.
[**If you believe small towns deserve a stronger voice in our politics — and a real shot at shaping our future — now is the time to step up. Please, make a donation today to help us reach our $100,000 goal before tomorrow at midnight.**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260429.DV5A2e&amount=5&refcode=em20260429-557&t=4&akid=557%2E34582%2EvIJCyP)

**[It’s time for Democrats to expand the map and put small towns back at the forefront: pitch in now to help build our movement from the ground up.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260429-557&t=24&refcode2=557_34582_vIJCyP&akid=557%2E34582%2EvIJCyP)**
